For a leading high-tech company in Eindhoven, we are looking for an accurate and motivated Cleanroom Precision Operator. In this role, you are responsible for processing valuable industrial components in a controlled cleanroom environment where quality, precision, and safety are the highest priorities.

Your daily responsibilities include:

- Cleaning high-tech components according to strict cleanroom procedures and work instructions.
- Performing assembly and packaging activities using approved materials and tools.
- Inspecting products with measuring equipment and carrying out quality checks.
- Reading and following technical drawings and detailed work instructions.
- Registering inspection results and production data in the quality system.
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process.
- Keeping the cleanroom and workplace clean, safe, and organized.

Working hours

You will work Monday through Friday in day shifts between 07:00 and 18:00.

- Minimum of 1 year experience in cleanroom, production, or assembly work
- Good command of the English language
- Ability to read and understand technical drawings
- Accurate and independent working attitude
- Willingness to work according to strict procedures and quality guidelines

Preferred

- Experience cleaning high-tech components
- Experience with quality measurements and measuring equipment

As a Customer Service Representative at a catering equipment company your role is to be the point of contact for our customers throughout Europe. These are hospitality businesses with questions related to ordering professional catering equipment. The advice that you will provide, along with a team of eight other colleagues, will range from queries to do with delivery, commercial issues and general support.Customer inquiries come in through phone calls, emails or our ticket system. You will be responsible for either forwarding them to the appropriate department or handling them yourself if they fall within your expertise.Outbound customer contact is just as important: you follow up on quotes and inform existing customers about our new products. There is also a lot of communication with colleagues from other departments when you have a question for your customer. So, there is plenty of variety!The main tasks include:- Customer contact via phone, email, or the ticket system
- Ticket system management: including assigning tickets to other departments
- Outbound contact: following up on quotes, informing existing customers about new productions 

RequirementsOur client is looking for someone who:
- Has an excellent understanding of French and English. Dutch would be a big plus
- Has had experience in a similar role
- Has received at least an intermediate vocational education (MBO) and can work and think at that level
- Has experience with customer support: both in a commercial and service-oriented capacity.
- Is available for 32-40 hours per week.

BenefitsIn this role you will enjoy a pleasant workplace with great equipment, quality furniture, air conditioning and a modern cafeteria with an outdoor terrace, access to free parking. - 25 vacation days with an option to purchase additional days.
- Holiday allowance (8%)
- Good pension scheme
- Travel reimbursement
- Sports subscription contribution (worth €600,- per year)
- Time and budget for personal development 

App

Get started in logistics at a growing DHL location

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and start working quickly? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for warehouse employees.

This is a site that is still developing: new clients are regularly being onboarded, so no two days are the same and you will continuously learn new tasks.

What will you do?

- Picking orders using a scanning system
- Checking and replenishing products
- Packing orders and preparing them for shipment
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Supporting various processes depending on the client
- Ensuring a clean and safe working environment

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate in three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are available 32 to 40 hours per week
- You are flexible and can perform multiple tasks
- You are physically capable of warehouse work
- You speak Dutch or English

Experience is not required – motivation and commitment are more important. You will receive proper training and learn the job step by step.

Do you want to put your forklift experience to use at our client DHL Freight in Eindhoven? Then this is your chance!
We are currently looking for a Forklift driver to join the team. In this role you will work in a dynamic logistics environment where accuracy and teamwork are key.

Your main tasks include:

- Loading and unloading trucks
- Operating a forklift safely and efficiently
- Weighing pallets

Requirements:

- Valid forklift certificate
- Minimum 6 months of experience as a forklift driver
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Full-time availability in a shift system

As an Assembly Employee, you are responsible for assembling plastic protection materials for high-tech products. You work accurately based on technical drawings and continuously check the quality of the final product.

Your tasks include:

- Assembling plastic components according to technical drawings
- Performing quality checks on dimensions and finishing
- Checking tolerances and product specifications
- Reporting deviations and improvement opportunities
- Processing and handling plastic materials
- Working together with colleagues from production and logistics
- Maintaining a clean and safe workplace

You will work in a 2-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- 06:00 - 15:00
- 15:00 - 00:00

You will receive additional compensation for weekend overtime.

For this position, we are looking for someone with technical insight and experience within a production environment.

Important requirements:

- Experience with plastic processing or plastic welding
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language
- Accurate and quality-focused work attitude
- Able to work well in a team
